The petitioner has filed this application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 with prayer for bail as he has been arrested on 04.05.2023 in connection with Bhuragaon P.S. Case No. 56/2023 under Section 376 IPC.
Heard Mr. R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. P.P., Assam, for the State respondent.

sentences.text: The F.I.R. unfolds that on 03.05.2023, the petitioner called the victim over phone and on 04.05.2023 the victim at night at around 1-00 A.M. went to meet him near one 12 wheeler truck bearing registration No. AS-JC-4636 which was parked after unloading the goods at Baralimari Market.
Initially the victim refused to go there, but as the petitioner insisted that he had some discussion with her, the victim went there and then the petitioner committed rape on her.
I have considered the submissions at the bar.
The petitioner is behind bars for 49 days.
I have perused the injury report of the victim along with the C.D.
It appears that further custodial detention for the progress of the investigation may not be required.

iii. The petitioner shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of concerned Police Station without obtaining prior written permission from the Court, till completion of investigation;
Return the C.D.
The bail application is disposed of.
